llm_response.reason: The domain was registered extremely recently (June 2025), with all registrant details hidden. The website imitates official Pokémon branding and product lines, but is not affiliated with The Pokémon Company, as official Pokémon commerce occurs on established domains like pokemon.com or pokemoncenter.com. The combination of trademark imitation, newness, masked ownership, and attempted brand spoofing matches multiple indicators of a Fake Online Shopping scam.
